source.stem:
A helicopter takes off from the ground and rises vertically. It then hovers at a constant height above the ground.
Which sequence of energy changes takes place during the gain in height?

intelligence.enrichment: An electric cell is a portable source of electrical energy with two terminals: the metal cap is positive and the metal disc is negative. cell terminal identity -> correct external connections -> electrical energy supplied to the circuit The learner correctly applies this rule: An electric cell is a portable source of electrical energy with two terminals: the metal cap is positive and the metal disc is negative. Either end of a cell can be called positive if the + mark is not noticed; cap and disc shape do not matter.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: circuits and cells. The student must decide: Decide which end of an electric cell is the positive terminal, which is the negative terminal, and why the cell can run a small circuit. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE.
